review_scope: Independent Q5-04 rerun review after Q5-04R model behavior repair, limited to report/state artifacts and local JSON/JSONL/hash/code-diff checks.

verdict.primary_reason: Q5-04R supplemental training rows exactly duplicate Q5-02 held-out prompts, candidate order, expected selected sets, and expected rejected sets for 12/12 held-out rows while marked training_eligible=true. The executable probe PASS is therefore contaminated by held-out answer leakage and cannot close Q5-04.

executable_probe_report.reviewer_interpretation: The probe proves the current checkpoint reproduces the Q5-02 expected labels, but those labels were added to training in Q5-04R, so this cannot prove candidate-position ablation readiness.

production_code_review.diff_summary: PromptContext aggregation changed from one top skill to a learned score-floor selected set with top-score fallback.
production_code_review.candidate_position_fallback_behavior: Fallback still emits CandidatePositionScaffoldEvidence, selected skills empty, confidence 0.0, RequiresSecondPass=true.
production_code_review.code_review_note: The code change is narrow and not candidate-order based, but the model behavior evidence is invalid until the training/evaluation split is repaired.

supplemental_training_rows_review.finding: The rows do not copy raw private text, but they do embed held-out expected answers and are marked eligible for training.

candidate_position_baseline_review.reviewer_interpretation: The baseline remains degraded, but the model-vs-baseline win is not admissible because the model trained on the held-out labels.

findings.title: Q5-04R trained on the Q5-02 held-out answer key
findings.evidence: PowerShell JSONL comparison found 12/12 Q5-04R supplemental rows with same prompt, same candidate order, same chosen set, and same rejected set as Q5-02 held-out rows. Each matching supplemental row is training_eligible=true.
findings.impact: The 24/24 executable probe result can be explained by training/evaluation leakage, so Q5-04 cannot prove candidate-position ablation readiness.
findings.required_repair: Remove Q5-02 held-out answer-key rows from eligible training, create source-disjoint supplemental semantic training rows that do not reuse held-out prompt/candidate/expected labels, regenerate the SkillSelection checkpoint/manifest/index from the repaired corpus, rerun the executable Q5-04 probe on Q5-02 held-out rows, and rerun this review.

commands_run: PowerShell JSONL comparison between Q5-02 held-out rows and Q5-04R supplemental training rows
PowerShell SHA256 consistency checks for checkpoint, manifest, model index, corpus snapshot, and supplemental rows
